description: Start every session from what Open Memory Lab holds for this agent's key, load its reviewed guardrails and check each matching tool call against them, and, when opted in, recall what it holds about a failed command.

hooks.command: command -v oml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook session-start || exit 0
command -v oml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook guardrails || exit 0
command -v oml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook guardrails || exit 0
command -v oml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook pre-tool-use --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook pre-tool-use
command -v oml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook tool-failure || exit 0
command -v oml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; oml hook session-end || exit 0
